I wanna know who's going where with who.|Moffi and Toffi on ''Good Morning, Coruscant'' during Investiture week|}} '''Moffi''' was a [[human]] that hosted the entertainment program ''[[Good Morning, Coruscant]]'' with fellow human host, [[Toffi]]. At the start of [[Senate Investiture]] [[Standard week|week]] in [[3 BBY]],"[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]" establishes that the events of "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]] occurr in [[3 BBY]]. Moffi wanted to focus on the parties being held during the holiday whereas Toffi wanted to talk about the politics. Moffi had light skin and [[color|blue]] [[eye|eyes]] and during the episode they had [[color|pink]] hair and wore a red [[Clothing|dress]] and purple [[glove]]s. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Moffi and Toffi were both portrayed by [[Ruby Wax]] and appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the season's fifth episode, "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]" which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{InsiderCite|236|Galactic Tales: A Death in Elderblock 26-0640}} {{Mo}} *{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=モフィ |ka=მოფი (პერსონაჟი) }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
